---
name: Task
about: Deliver a defined change with clear scope and verifiable results.
type: Task
---

<!-- Make this understandable without the original conversation. Keep the detail
proportional to the work: every task needs an outcome and acceptance criteria; keep
the other sections only when they add something, and state important unknowns.
Remove these guidance comments from the final issue. -->

## Outcome and context
<!-- What needs to change, and why? Describe the intended benefit, then what
happens today and essential context from earlier discussions or decisions. -->

## Scope and constraints
<!-- Define what this issue covers and any adjacent work it excludes. Identify
agreed constraints and existing behavior that must remain intact. Distinguish
requirements from suggested implementation approaches. -->

## Starting points
<!-- Link relevant code, existing patterns, designs, decisions or examples.
Explain what each reference contributes. Verify technical claims before stating
them as facts; mark unverified assumptions. Exact file paths are useful when known,
but do not invent them or require a complete implementation plan. -->

## Acceptance criteria
<!-- List observable results that complete this change as `- [ ]` checklist items,
including relevant failure cases. Describe the required outcomes rather than a
sequence of implementation steps. -->

## Verification
<!-- How will the criteria be checked? Identify useful scenarios, fixtures,
expected outputs or environments. Include checks specific to this change; use
repository instructions for routine checks. If the criteria already explain how
to verify the result, combine this section with them instead of repeating it. -->

## Dependencies and open questions
<!-- Set the parent epic and any blocking issues with GitHub's sub-issue and
blocked-by links; standalone tasks are welcome. Here, summarise decisions from the
epic that shape this work and say what each dependency blocks. State unanswered
questions and which must be resolved before implementation; do not supply assumed
answers. -->
